Optional looping joins the first and last rows in numeric and text wheels, including directional native adjustment and multi-lap drag. Direct entry and absolute actions keep the authored bounds. Inline quantity and unit pairs use independent states and names for numeric and text-choice fields, mirroring the row in RTL and stacking when space is limited. An anchored modeless popup keeps outside controls available, supports below and above placement and keeps Close visible beside its scrolling body. A centered modal holds the pair in a named scrolling body. It keeps its actions visible, contains keyboard focus, and gives the app one Save or Cancel for the pair. The Gallery reveals validation after a rejected Save and keeps pending edits through a temporarily short viewport. Display contrast supports the app's usual theme, a higher-contrast seeded theme, and browser forced colors. The wheel, popup and modal add a border on matching surfaces. In forced colors the extended renderer pairs selection background and text, including the selected part of a composition underline. Live operating system notifications, live input methods, VoiceOver speech, and Windows forced-color captures remain open.
